results.title: Technology trends in the creative and cultural industries sector
results.content: This article focuses on reviewing technology trends related to the creative and cultural industries (CCIs) and their impact on the development of cultural goods and services. In this context, technological trends, influencing the creation, production, circulation, and distribution of digital content, as well as its consumption and connection to the overall economy, play a key role in the development of CCIs and their contribution to the knowledge economy. For the purpose of this study, we classified 30 microtrends into 10 broader macrotrends based on their observable impact on the creation, production, and distribution of digital content within the creative and cultural industries (CCIs). This process highlighted recurrent terms, such as Smart Cities, Blockchain Disruption and NFT, Gig Economy, Immersive Technologies, Creation of New Products and Content to Improve the User Experience, Regulatory and Normative Frameworks, Business Model Opportunities, Changes in Consumer Behavior, and Market Performance (González-Sarmiento et al., 2021.
